title: Do you know where…? / I don't know what…

units.title: Do you know where…? / I don't know what…
units.rule: Savolni muloyim qilib soʻrash uchun *Do you know…?* bilan boshlaymiz: *Where is the bank?* → *Do you know where the bank is?* Diqqat: ichki qismda soʻz tartibi oddiy gapdagidek — avval ega, keyin feʼl: *where the bank is* (*where is the bank* emas). Present simple savoldagi *do/does* ichki qismda tushib qoladi: *Where does Aziz live?* → *Do you know where Aziz lives?* Xuddi shunday *I don't know…* bilan: *I don't know what time it is.* — Men soat nechaligini bilmayman.
examples: Do you know where the bank is?
Do you know what time it is?
I don't know where Aziz lives.
I don't know what this word means.
Do you know who that man is?
I don't know when the bus comes.

text.title: In Jizzax
text.en:
Aziz: Excuse me. Do you know where the bus station is?
Mr Kim: Sorry, I don't know. I'm new here.
Aziz: Do you know what time it is?
Mr Kim: Yes, it's two o'clock.
Aziz: Thank you. Do you know where Dilnoza lives?
Mr Kim: Yes, I do. She lives near the park. I don't know the street.
Aziz: I know the park! Thanks a lot.
